capabilities: Select Markdown notes from a folder and toggle each one in or out
Reorder selected notes with move up and move down buttons
Derive scene headings from the slugline property or the file name
Derive synopsis lines from the synopsis property or the first plain paragraph
Preview the outline and save a new .fountain file with pre-save checks
disambiguation: Not a screenplay editor; it only writes a new .fountain outline file and never changes the source notes.
extras: Freemium: core export is free; Pro ($5/month or $15 one-time via GitHub Sponsors) adds custom property names, output folder and file name settings, and saved note groups. Pro works offline up to 14 days after a check; sign-in uses the GitHub device flow and stores the token in Obsidian's secret storage. The README states the plugin was not tested on phones or tablets, output was not opened in a screenplay app, and speed with large folders was not measured. After updates it opens a 'What's new' tab suggesting other NoteMods plugins and Zovo Chat; requires Obsidian 1.13.4 or later.
problem: Obsidian stores scene planning as Markdown notes, but screenwriting apps read Fountain, and there is no built-in way to produce an ordered Fountain outline from a folder of scene notes.

requires.name: GitHub Sponsors sponsorship of theluckystrike for Pro features

summary: Fountain export tool that turns a folder of scene planning notes into an ordered .fountain screenplay outline with scene headings and synopses.
